intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Upland for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 3 (Free Photos with Santa and Santa's Workshop at the Tree Lighting Celebration) through December 12 (the 49th Hometown Holiday Parade), with Breakfast with Santa (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Upland

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Upland
  • 2 free events: Free Photos with Santa (December 3) and the Hometown Holiday Parade (December 12)
  • Meet Santa: Free Photos with Santa (December 3), Santa's Workshop at the Tree Lighting Celebration (December 3), Breakfast with Santa (December 5) and Santa at the end of the parade (December 12)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Tree Lighting Celebration in Historic Downtown Upland (December 3) and the Hometown Holiday Parade (December 12)
  • Trains: no holiday train in Upland itself (see our California Christmas train rides guide)
  • Season: December 3 to December 12

Planning a bigger day out? Upland families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Rancho Cucamonga, which covers Victoria Gardens Santa Photos and light shows, Snow Much Fun Day and The Nutcracker.
